description: Defines a template class 'executor_tracer' that wraps a task executor to add tracing of task enqueuing and execution times, including specializations for null tracers and factory functions for creating traced executors.

classes.name: executor_tracer
classes.description: A task executor that traces latencies of task enqueuing and invocation, with a specialization for null tracers.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a task with tracing of enqueue and run times.

methods.name: defer
methods.description: Defers a task with tracing of enqueue and run times.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Helper template to obtain a reference to the underlying executor or task.

methods.name: make_trace_executor
methods.description: Factory function to create an executor_tracer instance.

methods.name: make_trace_executor_ptr
methods.description: Factory function to create a std::unique_ptr to an executor_tracer.
